note: 100-card base set mixing current stars, rookies (35 RCs, no special numbering) and retired legends. Autographs are lettered by player initials (TA-xx etc.); 14 autograph groups included here, while relic-only inserts (Jumbo Relics, Milestone Relics, Stamp of Approval, Tributaries, Dual/Triple Relics) and color/serial parallels are omitted. Dual-auto cards list both signers in the player field; the Career Achievement Award set is 20 Barry Bonds cards numbered TCAA-BB1 to BB20.
